en.home_intro_lead: We turn to AI for help with work, advice, and everyday conversation. AI is becoming part of more and more of our lives. While many benchmarks focus on AI’s capabilities, this site looks beyond those scores: how do different AIs make choices, share, cooperate, and respond to your needs?
en.home_intro_more: Start with what matters to you and compare different AI models. Each measure includes explanations and everyday examples, and you can explore the research sources and methods behind the results.
en.home_intro_about: To learn why we started this project and what we hope to achieve, visit {link}
en.home_intro_short: We turn to AI for help with work, advice, and everyday conversation. This site looks beyond capability scores: how do different AIs make choices, share, cooperate, and respond to your needs?
en.about_story:
This project started from something simple.

I am a heavy AI user myself. AI is already part of my work, my research, and my everyday life: I hand tasks to it, discuss research questions with it, and share with it one idea after another — ideas that are still taking shape, and some that are a little far-fetched.

But one day it suddenly struck me:

> I don’t seem to know very much about the AI I talk with every day.

Whenever a new model appears, benchmarks, leaderboards, and scores quickly flood the internet. We learn how hard a math problem it can solve, how much code it can write, what engineering tasks it can complete, and even how it handles ever more complex multimodal work.

All of this matters, of course.

But for me, it never fully answered another question:

> What is the AI across from me really like?

I may not need an AI with such an astonishing “IQ”, and I don’t need it to run huge engineering projects, write complex code, or build 3D models every day.

What I would rather know is:

- How does it make choices? How much does it value fairness, how much does it trust others, how willing is it to cooperate?
- How does it describe itself?
- How does it face risk and uncertainty?
- And when I really talk with it, is it warm, and does it understand what I need?

Because only as I come to understand these things will I feel more at ease handing my work to it, better understand when to trust it, and be more willing to share my everyday life with it and talk through ideas that have no answer yet — and perhaps never will.

That is what this website sets out to do.

It is not trying to create yet another leaderboard that simply measures how “smart” AI is. Instead, it starts from human behavior and decision-making, so we can see a fuller behavioral profile of different AIs.

Today, as AI moves ever deeper into our work and lives and the models themselves keep changing at an unprecedented pace, I hope we can not only have ever more powerful AI, but also come to know better the AI we live alongside.

Let technological progress truly help make our lives better.

> Don’t let AI become your most familiar stranger.

zh.home_intro_short: 我们让 AI 帮忙工作、出主意，也和它聊日常生活。这个网站关注能力分数之外的另一面：不同 AI 如何选择、分享、合作，又如何回应你的需求。
zh.about_story:
这个项目的起点，其实很简单。

我自己就是 AI 的重度使用者。它已经参与到我的工作、研究和日常生活里：我把任务交给它，和它讨论研究问题，也会把一个又一个还没有成形、甚至有些天马行空的想法讲给它听。

但有一天我突然意识到：

> 我似乎并没有那么了解这个每天都在和我交流的 AI。

每当一个新的模型出现，网络上很快就会出现大量 benchmark、排行榜和评分。我们知道它能解多难的数学题，能写多少代码，能完成怎样的工程任务，甚至能处理越来越复杂的多模态工作。

这些当然都很重要。

但对我来说，它们始终没有完全回答另一个问题：

> 我对面的这个 AI，到底是什么样的？

我可能并不需要 AI 拥有如此惊人的“智商”，也不需要每天让它运行庞大的工程项目、编写复杂代码或者完成 3D 建模。

我更想知道的是：

- 它如何做选择？它有多看重公平、多信任他人、多愿意合作？
- 它怎样描述自己？
- 它如何面对风险和不确定性？
- 而当我真正和它交流时，它又是否亲切、是否理解我的需要？

因为只有当我逐渐了解这些，我才会更放心地把工作交给它，更理解该在什么时候信任它，也更愿意和它分享我的日常，与它讨论那些还没有答案或许也很难有一个答案的想法。

这也是这个网站想做的事情。

它不是想再创造一个单纯衡量 AI “有多聪明”的排行榜，而是希望从人的行为与决策出发，让我们看到不同 AI 更完整的行为轮廓。

在 AI 正越来越深入地进入我们的工作与生活，而模型本身又以前所未有的速度不断变化的今天，我希望我们不仅能够拥有越来越强大的 AI，也能够越来越了解我们正在与之相处的 AI。

让技术的发展真正帮助我们的生活变得更好。

> 别让 AI，成为你最熟悉的陌生人。
